+title: Give SkillDiscovery a combined view over the layer directories
+---
+## What
+
+`SkillDiscovery.discover()` (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Discovery/SkillDiscovery.swift:74`) replaces a full skill directory when a higher layer holds the same id. This is wrong. A higher layer must override only the files that it holds. All other files of the lower layers stay visible. This is the same rule as a combined (overlay) view of the layer trees.
+
+The comment in `SkillDiscovery.swift:10-14` says that the roots are the interface and that `DotfolderStack` is only a convenience. That text is a rationalization of an incorrect `DotfolderStack`. Remove it. `DotfolderStack` becomes directory-shaped in `FoundationModelsExtras`, and this package uses its combined view.
+
+Another agent makes the change in `FoundationModelsExtras`. Do not edit that repository. This card adopts the new API.
+
+1. **Bump the dependency.** `swift package update` for `FoundationModelsExtras`. If the directory-shaped API is not in the branch yet, stop and report the task as stuck. Do not write a local copy of the overlay in this package.
+2. **`DiscoveredSkill`** (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Discovery/DiscoveredSkill.swift`): replace `shadowedCandidates` with `contributingDirectories: [ContributingDirectory]`, ordered lowest precedence first. Each item holds `rootIndex`, `root` and `skillDirectory`. `skillDirectory`, `root` and `rootIndex` stay, and they name the layer that holds the winning `SKILL.md`.
+3. **`discover()`**: an id is found when a minimum of one layer holds `<root>/<id>/SKILL.md`. The winner of `SKILL.md` is the highest layer that holds it. Each layer that holds `<root>/<id>/` is a contributing directory, also a layer that holds no `SKILL.md`.
+4. Keep the shadow advisory of `plan.md` §4, but change its text: a lower directory is not replaced; only its copy of a file is overridden.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `DiscoveredSkill.contributingDirectories` gives each layer directory of the id, lowest precedence first, and the last item is the layer of the winning `SKILL.md`.
+- [ ] A lower layer that holds `<id>/` but no `SKILL.md` is in `contributingDirectories`.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` gives 0 warnings, and `swift test` is green.
+- [ ] No type in this package makes its own overlay walk; the combined view comes from `DotfolderStack`.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SkillDiscoveryTests.swift`: two layers hold `alpha/`; only the higher one holds `SKILL.md`; `contributingDirectories` has both, lowest first.
+- [ ] Same file: three layers hold the same id; the order of `contributingDirectories` is the order of the roots.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SkillWatcherTests.swift` or `SkillsRegistryReloadTests.swift`: a change to a file of a lower layer that no higher layer overrides causes one reload.
+- [ ] `swift test` — all tests pass, 0 failures.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+#dotfolder-overlay #skills #cross-repo
\ No newline at end of file

+`SkillDiscovery.discover()` (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Discovery/SkillDiscovery.swift:74`) replaces a full skill directory when a higher layer holds the same id. This is wrong. The unit of override is the file. A higher layer overrides only the files that it holds, and each other file of the lower layers stays visible.
+
+Example, with `defaults < user < project`:
+
+```
+defaults/review/SKILL.md             user/review/SKILL.md          project/review/references/house-style.md
+defaults/review/references/rules.md  user/review/scripts/lint.sh
+defaults/review/scripts/lint.sh
+defaults/review/scripts/report.sh
+```
+
+The skill `review` must give: `SKILL.md` from user, `scripts/lint.sh` from user, `scripts/report.sh` from defaults, `references/rules.md` from defaults, `references/house-style.md` from project. Today the user copy of `SKILL.md` hides `report.sh`, `rules.md` and `style.md`.
+
+The comment at `SkillDiscovery.swift:10-14` says that the roots are the interface and that `DotfolderStack` is only a convenience. That text, and `plan.md` decision #29, are a rationalization of a `DotfolderStack` that could not do this. Delete that reason; do not keep it.

-The comment in `SkillDiscovery.swift:10-14` says that the roots are the interface and that `DotfolderStack` is only a convenience. That text is a rationalization of an incorrect `DotfolderStack`. Remove it. `DotfolderStack` becomes directory-shaped in `FoundationModelsExtras`, and this package uses its combined view.
+**Dependency across repositories.** The combined view comes from the new `DotfolderStack` API in `FoundationModelsExtras` (`tree(_:)`, `childDirectories(of:)`, `layerDirectories(_:)`, card ^40n54dh on that board). Do not write a copy of the walk in this package. If the API is not in the branch of Extras yet, stop and report this task as stuck.

-Another agent makes the change in `FoundationModelsExtras`. Do not edit that repository. This card adopts the new API.
+## The work

-1. **Bump the dependency.** `swift package update` for `FoundationModelsExtras`. If the directory-shaped API is not in the branch yet, stop and report the task as stuck. Do not write a local copy of the overlay in this package.
-2. **`DiscoveredSkill`** (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Discovery/DiscoveredSkill.swift`): replace `shadowedCandidates` with `contributingDirectories: [ContributingDirectory]`, ordered lowest precedence first. Each item holds `rootIndex`, `root` and `skillDirectory`. `skillDirectory`, `root` and `rootIndex` stay, and they name the layer that holds the winning `SKILL.md`.
-3. **`discover()`**: an id is found when a minimum of one layer holds `<root>/<id>/SKILL.md`. The winner of `SKILL.md` is the highest layer that holds it. Each layer that holds `<root>/<id>/` is a contributing directory, also a layer that holds no `SKILL.md`.
-4. Keep the shadow advisory of `plan.md` §4, but change its text: a lower directory is not replaced; only its copy of a file is overridden.
+1. Bump `FoundationModelsExtras` with `swift package update`.
+2. `SkillDiscovery` takes the layers (`[DotfolderStack.Layer]`, lowest precedence first), not bare roots. Keep `init(stack:)`. `init(roots:)` stays for a host that gives bare roots; it wraps each root as it does now.
+3. `discover()` uses `childDirectories(of: nil)` to find each id of the union. An id counts when a minimum of one of its layer directories holds `SKILL.md`. Skip the names `.git` and `node_modules`.
+4. `DiscoveredSkill` (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Discovery/DiscoveredSkill.swift`): replace `shadowedCandidates` with `contributingDirectories: [ContributingDirectory]`, lowest precedence first. Each item holds `rootIndex`, `root` and `skillDirectory`. `skillDirectory`, `root` and `rootIndex` stay, and they name the layer of the winning `SKILL.md`.

 ## Acceptance Criteria

-- [ ] `DiscoveredSkill.contributingDirectories` gives each layer directory of the id, lowest precedence first, and the last item is the layer of the winning `SKILL.md`.
-- [ ] A lower layer that holds `<id>/` but no `SKILL.md` is in `contributingDirectories`.

+- [ ] The rationalization text at `SkillDiscovery.swift:10-14` is gone.
 - [ ] `swift build --build-tests` gives 0 warnings, and `swift test` is green.
-- [ ] No type in this package makes its own overlay walk; the combined view comes from `DotfolderStack`.

 ## Tests

-- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SkillDiscoveryTests.swift`: two layers hold `alpha/`; only the higher one holds `SKILL.md`; `contributingDirectories` has both, lowest first.
-- [ ] Same file: three layers hold the same id; the order of `contributingDirectories` is the order of the roots.
-- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SkillWatcherTests.swift` or `SkillsRegistryReloadTests.swift`: a change to a file of a lower layer that no higher layer overrides causes one reload.

+- [ ] Same file: an id that no layer gives a `SKILL.md` for is not discovered.
 - [ ] `swift test` — all tests pass, 0 failures.
